name: Queen of Elfland
text: Every 3rd End of Turn: destroy the units behind this (or this, if none). Split their printed Attack and Health, plus permanent buffs, evenly among your other Fairies.
golden_text: Every 3rd End of Turn: destroy the units behind this (or this, if none). Double their printed stats and permanent buffs, then split that Attack and Health evenly among your other Fairies.
